comparison.objective: Release a printed part by flexing a build plate, then bin the part and restore the plate.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually bend a deformable plate in the correct direction without exceeding its curvature limit.
comparison.success_condition: Part freed and binned; plate returned flat; no kink, drop, or excessive downward displacement.
comparison.reason: This is controlled deformable-object bending and part release. The candidate instead uses a hex bit and rotating collar to tune a rigid damper and validate dynamic stops.
